_note: Engine-owned storage, db and data-dir modules that Calls, Noodle and Slurp still bundle for reads (Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents#1487, contract Tier B). This list may only shrink: scripts/server-host-gates.mjs fails a build that bundles a module not listed here, or no longer bundles one that is. Every reason was checked by grepping the module for top-level Map, Set and let state.

reasons.packages/server/src/db/file-query.ts: stateless: verified (no top-level Map, Set or let). Query helpers over the Engine's file store handle passed in as app.db.
reasons.packages/server/src/db/file-schema.ts: stateless: verified. Table declarations keyed by the global Symbol.for("marinara:file-table"), shared with the Engine by design.
